The problem

Buying business IT is still a manual job.

01
Quotes you can't compare

Five suppliers, five portals, the same environment explained five times. Days later the quotes arrive on different specs, and the cheapest is missing the warranty.

02
Not knowing what you own

Machines of different ages, no record of warranty or licences. The information exists, scattered across suppliers.

03
Orders that arrive incomplete

A switch without the optics it needs, because nobody checked the build. One missing line becomes a return, a re-quote and a wasted site visit.

We built P-Com.ai on the buyer's side: you describe the job, we check it, supply it and keep the record, and that record is yours.

Inside the platform

It checks the build before the order goes out.
